payload.prompt: Write an email to a friend about your weekend plans. Say where you will go, who you will meet, and what you will do.
Describe your daily morning routine. Write about what time you get up, what you eat, and how you get to work or school.
Write a short message to a neighbour who is new in your area. Tell them about two useful places nearby, such as a shop or a park.
Write about your favourite food. Say what it is, when you eat it, and why you like it.
Write an email to a friend about a trip you took. Describe where you went, what you did, and say what you liked or disliked most.
Some people think children should have a phone from the age of ten. Do you agree? Give your opinion with at least two reasons.
Write a story that begins with this sentence: 'I missed the last bus home, so I had to make a difficult decision.' Say what happened next and how it ended.
Describe a person who has helped you in your life. Explain who this person is, what they did, and why it was important to you.
Write an essay about the advantages and disadvantages of working from home. Give examples and finish with your own conclusion.
Write a report for your school or company on how to reduce waste in your community. Describe two problems, suggest solutions, and recommend one of them.
If you could change one thing about the education system in your country, what would it be? Explain your idea, give reasons, and discuss possible problems.
Some people believe that technology makes us less social, while others say it brings us closer together. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
Tell me about your family. How many people are in it?
Where do you live? Is it a big or small place?
Describe your best friend. What does he or she look like, and what do you do together?
What do you usually do on Saturday? Who do you spend time with?
What kind of music do you like, and when do you listen to it?
Talk about a holiday or trip you remember well. Where did you go, who was with you, and what happened?
Describe a place in your town where you like to relax. Say what it looks like and why you enjoy it.
Do you think it is better to live in a city or in a village? Give reasons for your opinion.
Talk about a time when you had to learn something difficult. Explain how you did it and what you learned from the experience.
If you could live in any country for a year, where would you choose and why? Describe what you would do there.
Do you think social media has more advantages or disadvantages for young people? Explain your view with examples.
What would happen if people stopped using cars in big cities? Discuss the possible benefits and problems.
